indications.description: First-line EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.

treatment.schedule_summary: Dacomitinib 45 mg by mouth once daily continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity; individual dose modifications require Consultant review.
administration_instructions: Take at approximately the same time each day with or without food. Swallow tablets with water.
If missed or vomited, do not take a replacement dose; take the next prescribed dose at the usual time the following day.
Review acid-suppressing medicines and CYP2D6 substrates with pharmacy.

eligibility: NCCP 00565a: first-line adult activating-EGFR locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.
Validated EGFR test; ECOG 0–1; adequate renal, hepatic and haematological status.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to dacomitinib or excipients

baseline: Validated EGFR mutation, baseline staging scans.
FBC, renal, liver and bone profile.
regular: FBC, renal, liver and bone profile; frequency individualised as source does not specify an interval.
Early skin/diarrhoea assessment, hydration and medicine-interaction review.

dose_modifications.principle: Source-specific hold and recovery pathways; no automatic restart, no arithmetic combination of reductions.
conflicts: H2-receptor antagonist timing: NCCP ≥6 hours before/10 hours after vs EMA 2 hours before/≥10 hours after. Requires pharmacy reconciliation.
NCCP v3 published review date 23 June 2026 has passed; retrieved current linked source remains v3, not a claim of independent reapproval.
